extName.description: Extension name. Product name, do not translate.

extDescription.message: Claims channel points and drops, mutes ads, opens followed channels when they go live.

supportLinkLabel.message: Support the developer on Buy Me a Coffee

statusNoScript.message: No content script in this tab.

statusPartial.message: Content script is running but incomplete.

diagMissingHeader.message: Not loaded. The first entry is the root cause:

diagStartupFailed.message: All files loaded, but startup did not finish. Check the Log tab.

injectNothing.message: Nothing to inject. Reload the Twitch tab manually (F5).

liveHintStale.message: No fresh data. Auto-join needs at least one open, logged-in Twitch tab.

liveHintEmpty.message: Sidebar is empty. You are probably logged out.

optDropsOpenInventory.message: Then open the inventory in a background tab

hintDrops.message: Clicks happen on the inventory page only. Everywhere else the notification is read, never clicked, so no click path exists on channel pages. The interval is a safety net for missed notifications.

optAutoJoinEnabled.message: Open channels as soon as they go live

optAutoJoinClose.message: Close the tab when the channel goes offline

hintAutoJoin.message: Driven by the followed-channels sidebar. A logged-in Twitch tab must be open and you have to follow the channel.

optAdMuteOverlay.message: Cover the player with an overlay

hintAdMute.message: Not an ad blocker. Twitch stitches ads into the same stream (SSAI), so there is no request to block. Ads keep playing, you just do not see or hear them.

optViewerStatsPanel.message: Show the panel on the page

viewerNoticeTitle.message: This is not a fake-viewer detector.

viewerNoticeBody.message: Twitch does not expose a viewer list, so nobody can tell from the outside whether a viewer is real. What follows are measured raw values. Low chat activity is normal for music, chess or watch-party streams, and small channels scatter heavily. The reading is yours to make.

viewerMetaInactive.message: Measurement inactive. Open a channel and enable the module.

viewerMeta.message: Window $1 min · $2 messages captured · $3 min observed

viewerBaseline.message: Rough field baseline: 5 to 30 active chatters per 1000 viewers is typical for gaming channels. Well below that can point to botting, but just as easily to a passive category, a follower-only chat, or a quiet stretch.
